The dataset "subset_white_final_GE.Rdata" contains all RAW variables needed for GE mediations including all RAW GE (51 genes) (**before** transformations and stress categories creation), but after the imputation and after removing individual with diseases (see previous step).


```{r}
load("../data/subset_white_final_GE.Rdata")
st_categ <- read.csv("../data/stress_categories.csv")
library(dplyr)
```


# 1) Dichotomization and grouping by subcategories: 


```{r}
# Make a copy of the dataset before creating category-level stress scores.
subset_white_final_GE_dic <- subset_white_final_GE

# Use only CF-selected individual stressors and attach category/range metadata.
selected_stressor_info <- st_categ %>%
  distinct(Variable, category, value_range) %>%
  arrange(category, Variable)

missing_ranges <- selected_stressor_info %>%
  filter(is.na(value_range) | value_range == "" | value_range == "NA")
if (nrow(missing_ranges) > 0) {
  stop("These CF-selected stressors have missing value_range metadata: ",
       paste(missing_ranges$Variable, collapse = ", "))
}

make_score_name <- function(category_name) {
  score_name <- tolower(category_name)
  score_name <- gsub("\\s*-\\s*", "_", score_name)
  score_name <- gsub("[^a-z0-9]+", "_", score_name)
  score_name <- gsub("_+", "_", score_name)
  score_name <- gsub("^_|_$", "", score_name)
  paste0(score_name, "_score")
}

transform_by_value_range <- function(x, value_range) {
  range_parts <- strsplit(value_range, "to", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  if (length(range_parts) != 2) {
    stop("Unsupported value_range format: ", value_range)
  }

  min_value <- as.numeric(range_parts[1])
  max_value <- as.numeric(range_parts[2])
  if (is.na(min_value) || is.na(max_value)) {
    stop("Unsupported value_range format: ", value_range)
  }

  high_stress_cutoff <- floor((min_value + max_value) / 2) + 1
  ifelse(is.na(x), NA_integer_, ifelse(x >= high_stress_cutoff, 1L, 0L))
}

category_score_key <- selected_stressor_info %>%
  distinct(category) %>%
  mutate(score_var = make_score_name(category))

for (current_category in category_score_key$category) {
  category_vars <- selected_stressor_info %>%
    filter(category == current_category)

  missing_dataset_vars <- setdiff(category_vars$Variable, names(subset_white_final_GE_dic))
  if (length(missing_dataset_vars) > 0) {
    stop("These selected stressors are missing from subset_white_final_GE: ",
         paste(missing_dataset_vars, collapse = ", "))
  }

  transformed_matrix <- sapply(seq_len(nrow(category_vars)), function(i) {
    current_var <- category_vars$Variable[i]
    current_range <- category_vars$value_range[i]
    transform_by_value_range(subset_white_final_GE_dic[[current_var]], current_range)
  })

  if (is.null(dim(transformed_matrix))) {
    transformed_matrix <- matrix(transformed_matrix, ncol = 1)
  }
  colnames(transformed_matrix) <- category_vars$Variable

  score_var <- category_score_key$score_var[category_score_key$category == current_category]
  subset_white_final_GE_dic[[score_var]] <- rowSums(transformed_matrix, na.rm = FALSE)
}

stressors_cat <- category_score_key$score_var

selected_stressor_info
category_score_key
lapply(stressors_cat, function(x) table(subset_white_final_GE_dic[[x]], useNA = "ifany"))

# Diagnostic: complete-case N per category score, to flag power loss from NA propagation
cat("\nComplete-case N per category score (rowSums with na.rm = FALSE propagates NA):\n")
for (score_var in stressors_cat) {
  cat(" -", score_var, ":", sum(!is.na(subset_white_final_GE_dic[[score_var]])),
      "/", nrow(subset_white_final_GE_dic), "\n")
}

```

```{r}
category_score_summary <- selected_stressor_info %>%
  group_by(category) %>%
  summarise(
    score_var = make_score_name(first(category)),
    n_variables = n(),
    variables = paste(Variable, collapse = ", "),
    original_value_ranges = paste(unique(value_range), collapse = ", "),
    dichotomized_variable_range = "0to1",
    category_score_possible_range = paste0("0to", n_variables),
    category_score_observed_range = paste0(
      min(subset_white_final_GE_dic[[score_var]], na.rm = TRUE),
      "to",
      max(subset_white_final_GE_dic[[score_var]], na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(match(score_var, stressors_cat))

category_score_summary
```

### - Remove genes with low counts:

Remove genes with average expression level < 0.5 log2 CPM reads.

```{r}

# Identify genes with low counts:
remove_genes = list()  
for (gene in all_genes) {
  # Check the mean expression of the gene:
  if (mean(subset_white_final_GE_dic[[gene]]) <=0.55) {
    remove_genes = append(remove_genes, gene)  # Append the gene to the list
  }
}
remove_genes  


# Remove those 9 genes from the list: 
dim(subset_white_final_GE_dic)
subset_white_final_GE_dic=subset_white_final_GE_dic[,!colnames(subset_white_final_GE_dic) %in% remove_genes]
dim(subset_white_final_GE_dic)

# Update the gene list:
all_genes = all_genes[!all_genes %in% remove_genes] 
all_genes 

```

Although the GE RAW data of some genes seems to be approximately normal distributed or slightly skewed, I would need to transform them or to select different models (!= lm). 


### - GE transformations:

```{r}
# New dataset to transform the genes on it: 
subset_white_final_GE_dic_trans <- subset_white_final_GE_dic

# Apply inverse-normal transformation to all 42 genes:
head(subset_white_final_GE_dic_trans[, all_genes])

for (gene in all_genes) {
  subset_white_final_GE_dic_trans[[gene]] <- qnorm((rank(subset_white_final_GE_dic_trans[[gene]], na.last = "keep") - 0.5) / sum(!is.na(subset_white_final_GE_dic_trans[[gene]])))
}

head(subset_white_final_GE_dic_trans[, all_genes])


```

####.Poisson models:
  
```{r}
  library(performance) # to conduct overdispersion test

  CFs_poisson= c("C3TWLITU", "C3TDBS", "C3TNSTOT")
  
  ### Plot model_Y's residuals to make model diagnostics:
  # Loop through each CF:
  for (CF in CFs_poisson) {
    # Loop through each gene
    for (gene in all_genes) {
      # Loop through each stressor_cat
      for (stress in stressors_cat) {
        # Define the model: CF ~ stress + gene:
        model_Y = glm(as.formula(paste(CF, "~", stress, "+", gene, "+ C1PRSEX + C1PRAGE + SES + C1SBMI   + C1SA26F + C1SA11T")),
                      family = poisson(link = "log"),
                      data = subset_white_final_GE_dic_trans)
        
        # Run Overdispersion Test
        ov_output <- capture.output({
          cat("\n\n## Overdispersion result for:", gene, "~", stress, "##\n")
          check_overdispersion(model_Y)
        })
        cat(ov_output, sep = "\n", file = "../outs/GE_Final_diagnostics_Model_Y_Poisson_Overdispersion_results.txt", append = TRUE)
      }
    }
  }
  
```
  

## Gene composite scores:

```{r}
####### 1) Following Abner's method:
pro_inf_genes=c("RA6RFOS", "RA6RFOSB", "RA6RFOSL2", "RA6RIL1B", "RA6RJUN", "RA6RJUNB",
  "RA6RJUND", "RA6RNFKB1", "RA6RNFKB2", "RA6RPTGS1", "RA6RPTGS2", "RA6RREL", "RA6RRELA", "RA6RRELB", "RA6RTNF" )
antiviral_genes= c("RA6RGBP1", "RA6RIFI16", "RA6RIFI27L1", "RA6RIFI27L2", "RA6RIFI30", "RA6RIFI35", "RA6RIFI44", "RA6RIFI44L", "RA6RIFI6", "RA6RIFIH1", "RA6RIFIT1", "RA6RIFIT2", "RA6RIFIT3", "RA6RIFIT5", "RA6RIFITM1", "RA6RIFITM2", "RA6RIFITM3", "RA6RIRF2", "RA6RIRF7", "RA6RIRF8", "RA6RJCHAIN", "RA6RMX1", "RA6RMX2", "RA6ROAS1", "RA6ROAS2", "RA6ROAS3", "RA6ROASL") 


# Within-gene mean-centre all expression columns 
expr_centered <- subset_white_final_GE_dic_trans[ , c(pro_inf_genes, antiviral_genes) ]
expr_centered <- sweep(expr_centered, 2, colMeans(expr_centered, na.rm = TRUE), FUN = "-")

#  Row-average to get the two sub-scores 
subset_white_final_GE_dic_trans$proinflam <- rowMeans(expr_centered[ , pro_inf_genes], na.rm = TRUE)
subset_white_final_GE_dic_trans$antiviral <- rowMeans(expr_centered[ , antiviral_genes], na.rm = TRUE)

##### Overall CTRA score  (pro - antiviral)=
subset_white_final_GE_dic_trans$ctra   <- subset_white_final_GE_dic_trans$proinflam   -   subset_white_final_GE_dic_trans$antiviral

#Sample-mean-centre the three composite scores 
subset_white_final_GE_dic_trans$proinflam <- scale(subset_white_final_GE_dic_trans$proinflam,  center = TRUE, scale = FALSE)[ ,1]
subset_white_final_GE_dic_trans$antiviral <- scale(subset_white_final_GE_dic_trans$antiviral, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE)[ ,1]
subset_white_final_GE_dic_trans$ctra <- scale(subset_white_final_GE_dic_trans$ctra, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE)[ ,1]

```




```{r}
###### 2) Using hirerchical clustering:

# 1. Extract the expression matrix for all genes
ALLexpr_mat <- subset_white_final_GE_dic_trans[ , all_genes]

# 2. Z-score each gene (mean = 0, SD = 1)
ALLexpr_z <- scale(ALLexpr_mat)  # samples × genes

# 3. Distance and clustering
ALLd <- dist(t(ALLexpr_z), method = "euclidean")   # distance between genes
ALLhc  <- hclust(ALLd, method = "ward.D2")

plot(ALLhc, hang = -1)  # plot the dendrogram
axis(side = 2, at = seq(0, max(ALLhc$height), by = 1))  # add more y-axis ticks every 5 units

```


```{r}
# 4. Decide number of clusters
k <- 9   # or use: ALLgene_grp <- cutree(ALLhc, h = 31)
ALLgene_grp <- cutree(ALLhc, h = 20)  # named vector: gene → cluster

# 5. Print clusters
for (g in 1:k) {
  cat(paste0("Cluster ", g, ": \n"))
  print(names(ALLgene_grp)[ALLgene_grp == g])
}

# 6. Compare mean vs median
for (g in 1:k) {
  genes <- names(ALLgene_grp)[ALLgene_grp == g]
  m  <- rowMeans(ALLexpr_z[, genes, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
  med   <- matrixStats::rowMedians(as.matrix(ALLexpr_z[, genes]), na.rm = TRUE)
  cat("Cluster", g, "correlation(mean, median) =", round(cor(m, med, use = "pair"), 4), "\n")
}
```



-----> I will omit cluster 7 because it only has a gene on it. 


```{r}
# 7. Build cluster scores using means
library(dplyr)
for (g in setdiff(1:k, 7)) {  # exclude cluster 7
  genes_in_g <- names(ALLgene_grp)[ALLgene_grp == g]
  col_name   <- paste0("ALLcluster", g , "mean")
  subset_white_final_GE_dic_trans[[col_name]] <-
      rowMeans(ALLexpr_z[ , genes_in_g, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
}


# 8. Build cluster scores using eigengenes (PC1)
library(tidyverse)
ALLpc_var_expl <- numeric(k) # variance explained container

for (g in setdiff(1:k, 7)) {  # exclude cluster 7
  genes_g <- names(ALLgene_grp)[ALLgene_grp == g]
  pca_g  <- prcomp(ALLexpr_z[ , genes_g, drop = FALSE], center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)
  eig <- pca_g$x[ , 1]
  col_nm<- paste0("ALLcluster", g, "eig")
  subset_white_final_GE_dic_trans[[col_nm]] <- eig
  ALLpc_var_expl[g] <- (pca_g$sdev[1]^2) / sum(pca_g$sdev^2)
}

ALLvar_df <- tibble(
  cluster = paste0("ALLcluster", setdiff(1:k, 7)),
  PC1_var = round(ALLpc_var_expl[setdiff(1:k, 7)] * 100, 1)
)
ALLvar_df

```
